videos.caption: 9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

Moroccon history edit 🇲🇦☀️ | Song: Baixo Cristal Teclas Morocco, officially the Kingdom of Morocco, is a country located in the northwest corner of Africa. It borders the Atlantic Ocean, the Mediterranean Sea, Algeria, and Western Sahara, making it one of the most strategically located nations on the continent. Its unique position has allowed it to serve as a bridge between Africa, Europe, and the Middle East for thousands of years. Morocco has one of the richest histories in Africa. It was home to the Amazigh (Berber) peoples long before the arrival of Islam in the 7th century. Over the centuries, powerful dynasties such as the Almoravids, Almohads, Saadians, and Alaouites transformed Morocco into one of the strongest states in North Africa. At their height, Moroccan empires ruled territories stretching into modern-day Algeria, Mauritania, Mali, and southern Spain. The country also remained independent from the Ottoman Empire and successfully defended itself against several European invasions. Today, Morocco is known for its diverse landscapes, from the snowy Atlas Mountains to the vast Sahara Desert and its long Atlantic and Mediterranean coastlines. Its cities, including Rabat, Casablanca, Marrakesh, and Fez, are famous for their historic architecture, colorful markets, and rich cultural traditions. Moroccan culture blends Amazigh, Arab, Andalusian, African, and European influences. The country is renowned for its cuisine, traditional craftsmanship, music, and hospitality. Dishes such as tagine and couscous are enjoyed worldwide, while Moroccan mint tea has become a symbol of welcoming guests. In recent decades, Morocco has developed one of Africa's largest economies, with strengths in tourism, agriculture, automotive manufacturing, renewable energy, and phosphate production. The country also gained worldwide recognition when its national football team became the first African nation to reach the FIFA World Cup semifinals in 2022. With over a thousand years of continuous statehood, a rich imperial history, diverse landscapes, and a unique blend of cultures, Morocco remains one of Africa's most influential and historically significant countries. #FYP #Morocco #History #FY #creatorsearchinsights  @🇱🇰✝️ 𝓛𝓪𝓷𝓴𝓪𝓷✝️🇱🇰 (tournament)

Would you wander Marrakech alone?  One thing I was honestly nervous about before coming to Marrakech for the first time was safety, especially as a woman travelling alone. Social media can make the medina look super intimidating, chaotic, and overwhelming, but my experience has actually been really positive. Of course you need to stay aware like in any big city, but I’ve spent hours wandering the souks, getting lost in little alleyways, shopping, stopping for mint tea, and exploring on my own and I genuinely felt okay. One thing that helped SO much this time was not carrying all my luggage around with me 😅 dragging a huge backpack through crowded streets instantly makes you feel more stressed and overwhelmed. I used @bounce luggage storage so I could explore Marrakech freely for the day before my riad check-in, and it made such a difference. I could actually enjoy the medina instead of worrying about my bags the entire time. Bounce has thousands of locations worldwide and is a super reliable resource if you find yourself in a similar situation as me. Pegunungan Atlas di Maroko mendadak diterjang banjir bandang! Air di kawasan Oum Er-Rbia yang biasanya menjadi salah satu tujuan wisata, tiba-tiba berubah menjadi arus deras setelah hujan lebat mengguyur wilayah tersebut. Peristiwa ini terjadi di sekitar mata air Oum Er-Rbia, dekat Khénifra, Maroko, pada 8 September 2026. Hujan deras menyebabkan debit air meningkat dengan cepat hingga aliran air meluap dan menerjang kawasan di sekitarnya. Dahsyatnya arus bahkan merusak sejumlah infrastruktur wisata** yang berada di sekitar aliran air. Dalam hitungan waktu singkat, kawasan yang biasanya terlihat tenang berubah menjadi aliran air yang sangat deras. Kondisi seperti ini sangat berbahaya di daerah pegunungan. Ketika hujan turun dengan intensitas tinggi, air dapat terkumpul dan mengalir dengan cepat melalui lembah, sungai, dan jalur alami di antara bebatuan. Inilah yang membuat banjir bandang begitu sulit diprediksi oleh orang yang berada terlalu dekat dengan aliran air. Peristiwa di Oum Er-Rbia menjadi pengingat bahwa **kawasan sungai, mata air, dan lembah pegunungan bisa berubah drastis ketika hujan ekstrem terjadi. Dan pemandangan yang terlihat indah beberapa menit sebelumnya… bisa berubah menjadi arus yang sangat berbahaya. 🌊 Jangan pernah menganggap remeh air yang terlihat tenang karena di pegunungan, situasinya bisa berubah jauh lebih cepat dari yang kita bayangkan. #BanjirBandang #Maroko #PegununganAtlas #BeritaDunia #FYP
